external_entities.name: Stripe

external_entities.name: Analytics team

processes.name: CloudFront
processes.description: Serves the React single-page web app to the public internet and has AWS WAF request limiting.
processes.source_excerpt: CloudFront serves it to the public internet over HTTPS with TLS 1.3

processes.name: React single-page web app
processes.description: A publicly loadable React single-page web application that calls the Orders API.

processes.name: Orders API
processes.description: An internal API that authenticates requests, rate-limits customers, reads and writes orders, handles support administration, and records audit actions.
processes.source_excerpt: The web app calls an internal Orders API in our AWS VPC over HTTPS.

processes.name: Nightly batch job
processes.description: A nightly VPC job that reads at most one day of orders and writes summaries to S3.
processes.source_excerpt: A nightly batch job in the VPC reads at most one day of orders over TLS

processes.name: Athena
processes.description: A query service used by the analytics team to query the summaries bucket.
processes.source_excerpt: query that bucket through Athena, which reads it over TLS

data_stores.name: Postgres database
data_stores.description: A Postgres database holding customer names, delivery addresses, phone numbers and order history.
data_stores.source_excerpt: It holds customer names, delivery addresses, phone numbers, and order history

data_stores.name: Database snapshots
data_stores.description: Database snapshots that the platform team can copy or restore.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Only the platform team can copy or restore the database snapshots

data_stores.name: S3 bucket
data_stores.description: A KMS-encrypted bucket containing nightly order summaries.

data_stores.name: CloudWatch Logs audit log
data_stores.description: A KMS-encrypted audit log to which the Orders API writes administrative actions; administrators cannot change it.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a KMS- encrypted CloudWatch Logs audit log that administrators cannot change

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: Customer authentication using a password and MFA.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Customers sign in to our Auth0 identity provider over HTTPS with TLS 1.3, using a password and MFA.

data_flows.name: load app
data_flows.description: Customer loads the React single-page web app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Anyone can load our React single-page web app without signing in

data_flows.name: call API
data_flows.description: The web app calls the Orders API with an Auth0 OAuth2 bearer token.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The web app calls an internal Orders API in our AWS VPC over HTTPS. Every call carries an Auth0 OAuth2 bearer token

data_flows.name: read-write orders
data_flows.description: Orders API reads and writes the Postgres database using IAM database authentication.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The Orders API reads and writes a Postgres database in a private subnet over TLS, with IAM database authentication.
data_flows.data_description: Customer names, delivery addresses, phone numbers and order history

data_flows.name: payment authorisation
data_flows.description: Orders API sends payment authorisation to Stripe using a secret API key.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Payment authorisation goes to Stripe over HTTPS with a secret API key

data_flows.name: read orders
data_flows.description: Nightly batch job reads at most one day of orders with a read-only database role.
data_flows.source_excerpt: A nightly batch job in the VPC reads at most one day of orders over TLS with a read-only database role.
data_flows.data_description: At most one day of orders

data_flows.name: write summaries
data_flows.description: Nightly batch job writes summaries to the KMS-encrypted S3 bucket using its own IAM role.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It writes summaries over HTTPS, with its own IAM role, to a KMS-encrypted S3 bucket.

data_flows.name: query bucket
data_flows.description: Analytics team queries the summaries through Athena.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The analytics team, a group of internal analysts, query that bucket through Athena

data_flows.name: read summaries
data_flows.description: Athena reads the summaries bucket over TLS using read-only IAM roles.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Athena, which reads it over TLS, with read- only IAM roles

data_flows.name: administer orders
data_flows.description: Support administrator performs refunds, delivery-address edits and order-history lookups through the admin console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Through it they refund orders, edit delivery addresses, and look up order history.
data_flows.data_description: Refunds, delivery addresses and order history

data_flows.name: write audit actions
data_flows.description: Orders API writes each administrative action to the audit log using its IAM role.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The API writes each action over HTTPS, with its IAM role, to a KMS- encrypted CloudWatch Logs audit log

data_flows.name: copy restore snapshots
data_flows.description: Platform team copies or restores database snapshots using IAM roles with SSO and MFA.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Only the platform team can copy or restore the database snapshots, the bucket and the audit log, through IAM roles with SSO and MFA over HTTPS.
data_flows.authentication: IAM roles with SSO and MFA

data_flows.name: copy restore bucket
data_flows.description: Platform team copies or restores the S3 bucket using IAM roles with SSO and MFA.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Only the platform team can copy or restore the database snapshots, the bucket and the audit log, through IAM roles with SSO and MFA over HTTPS.
data_flows.authentication: IAM roles with SSO and MFA

data_flows.name: copy restore audit log
data_flows.description: Platform team copies or restores the audit log using IAM roles with SSO and MFA.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Only the platform team can copy or restore the database snapshots, the bucket and the audit log, through IAM roles with SSO and MFA over HTTPS.
data_flows.authentication: IAM roles with SSO and MFA
